fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) has risen 70% from early 2026, emerging as the semiconductor industry's top performer, significantly outpacing major peers including Broadcom, QUALCOMM, and NVIDIA.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 revenue reached $6.06B (28% increase YoY), non-GAAP EPS was $2.62 (77% increase YoY), while Q4 guidance indicated 37% growth YoY.
fields.summary_ko.2: Driven by increased AI infrastructure demand, strong cash generation, and expanded manufacturing capacity investments, 2026 and 2027 revenue growth rates are expected at 26.4% and 15.4% respectively, with EPS growth rates of 64.6% and 25.3%.
